explication: This repository provides Frida scripts for intercepting mobile-app HTTPS traffic through a configured MitM proxy. The principal workflow is to configure the proxy and CA, inject the scripts into a target app, redirect its connections, and make its TLS checks accept the CA; platform-specific scripts also bypass pinning and device-integrity checks. The graph preserves Android and iOS branches and the native TLS layer. Relationships for unsampled scripts are included only where the README documents the capability or launch workflow.
